Gate queues explained overnight
This article covers the basics for people travelling soon
Companion Animal Travel Desk guidance for urgent travel

If you are arranging travel with a companion animal, act at once and follow the stated process with care. Safety takes priority over speed on every journey, and our team will review each step in a calm, orderly way so the booking remains valid and the animal is protected.

<<FACT F092>> Please keep all other details ready before you arrive, including your travel documents and any papers the staff may need to see. Delay can create serious problems at the airport, so do not wait until the last moment to begin.

When you contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk, the booking review must include the required form. <<FACT F085>> Bring the completed material exactly as requested, because missing paperwork can interrupt acceptance and force a separate review.

If your route involves a change of aircraft or a special handling request, tell the coordinator early and stay available for follow-up. The staff may ask for further confirmation, and those steps exist to reduce risk for your animal and for other travelers.

If a concern arises, the issue will move through a calm stepwise review rather than a rushed decision. This protects the booking, gives the team a clear record, and helps prevent avoidable refusal at the airport. Travelers should remain patient, answer requests promptly, and keep their documents within reach.

For urgent assistance, contact Aurelia Skyways and ask for the Companion Animal Travel Desk immediately.
